sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा विदित्वा च सीता जनकनन्दिनी ।आह रावणमुत्साद्य राघवो मां नयत्विति ।। ५.५८.९९ ।।।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā viditvā ca sītā janakanandinī ।āha rāvaṇamutsādya rāghavo māṁ nayatviti ।। 5.58.99 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard all that (Hanuman said) Sita, the delight of Janaka thought over and said, 'Rama should kill Ravana and take me'.
